// Exact signed 64-bit increment with a process-scoped synchronization primitive.
// This is a support probe, not a published helper or a compiler workaround.
const builds = new BigInt64Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(8));
function nextBuildCount(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asIntN(64, Atomics.add(builds, 0, 1n) + 1n);
}
for(const start of [0n, 9007199254740991n, 9223372036854775806n]) {
    builds[0] = start;
    for(let index = 0; index < 3; index++) { console.log(nextBuildCount().toString()); }
}
